title: Siblings, with the root as its own ancestor
notes: G and H share the parent D. Every jump, even of 1, lands both on the same vertex, so they never jump: the answer is their parent, D. With the root as its own ancestor (see the options) the jumps past the root give A instead of NIL. Same answer.
ops: A-B, A-C, B-D, B-E, C-F, D-G, D-H, E-I, F-J
